name: single_line
note: One-line range: the minimal anchor the writer can emit.

name: multi_line_ordinary
note: Ordinary multi-line range; the baseline every equivalence case below compares against.

name: subrange_middle
note: A range covering only interior lines, proving lines outside [start, end] never enter the hash.

name: body_no_blanks
note: Two-line body used as the counterpart for the blank-line and whitespace equivalences.

name: blank_lines_leading
note: Blank lines at the start of the range are discarded, not hashed as empty entries.

name: blank_lines_trailing
note: Blank lines at the end of the range are discarded.

name: blank_lines_middle
note: A blank line inside the range is discarded, so inserting one does not drift a note.

name: middle_whitespace_only_line
note: A line of only spaces and tabs normalises to empty and is discarded like a truly blank line.

name: tabs_indent
note: Tab-indented code; the counterpart for the re-indentation equivalence.

name: spaces_indent_same_hash
note: Same code re-indented with spaces must hash identically: re-indentation never drifts a note.

name: renamed_identifier_differs
note: Renaming an identifier changes the hash, so a note over renamed code drifts.

name: statement_one_line
input_lines: var client = new HttpClient(handler, disposeHandler: false);
note: Single-line statement; the counterpart for the reflow case.

name: statement_reflowed_differs
note: Reflowing one statement across two lines changes the hash, because lines are joined with \n not a space.

name: collapse_internal_run
note: Internal runs of spaces and tabs collapse to exactly one space.

name: single_space_internal
note: Already-single-spaced counterpart proving the collapse target is one U+0020.

name: form_feed_is_whitespace
note: U+000C FORM FEED is in the whitespace set, so it collapses to a space.

name: nbsp_is_content_differs
note: U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE is content, not whitespace: it must not collapse. Pins the set against isWhitespace().

name: crlf_multi_line_same_hash
note: CRLF line endings hash identically to LF: terminators are normalised before splitting.

name: lone_cr_multi_line_same_hash
note: Lone CR (classic Mac) endings hash identically to LF: a bare \r is a terminator, not content.

name: lone_cr_non_ascii_same_hash
note: Lone CR with multi-byte characters: terminator normalisation does not disturb UTF-8 sequences.

name: no_trailing_newline_same_hash
note: A file with no terminator on its last line hashes the same as one that has it.

name: end_past_eof_clamped
note: end past end of file clamps to the last line; no error, and no trailing empty line is invented.

name: end_one_past_eof_is_not_a_blank_line
note: The trailing newline does not create line 6, so end=6 on a 5-line file equals end=5.

name: only_blank_lines
note: A range of only blank lines normalises to the empty string; hash is SHA-256 of zero bytes.

name: only_whitespace_lines
note: Spaces-only, tab-only and form-feed-only lines all normalise to empty.

name: single_empty_line_range
note: The empty-normalised-content case in its smallest form.

name: start_past_eof_empty
note: start past end of file selects no lines and yields the empty-content hash rather than erroring.

name: empty_file
note: A zero-line file has no lines at all, so any range over it is empty.

name: non_ascii_string_literal
note: Non-ASCII content is hashed as its UTF-8 bytes with no Unicode normalisation.

name: non_ascii_crlf_same_hash
note: Non-ASCII plus CRLF: multi-byte characters do not interact with terminator normalisation.

name: error_start_greater_than_end
note: start > end is a caller bug the resolver never produces, so it is rejected loudly.

name: error_start_below_one
note: Lines are 1-based; start < 1 is rejected rather than clamped.
